functional_reqs.requirement_text: The mobile application shall be available on Android devices.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Platform availability is an explicit product capability and can be verified by releasing and running the app on Android.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The mobile application shall be available on iOS devices.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Platform availability is an explicit product capability and can be verified by releasing and running the app on iOS.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to view current football news for their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "To achieve this, users can display current football news of their favorite teams"
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Displaying team-specific news is a core user-facing feature described directly in the research.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to select preferred sports channels individually.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "and also select preferred sports channels individually."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Individual source/channel selection is explicitly requested as a personalization feature.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall provide a live ticker for users to follow live results of their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition to the news, users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: The live ticker is a central functional capability for real-time match tracking.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall provide coverage of national football leagues and competitions.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: National competition coverage is part of the stated scope of content coverage.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall provide coverage of international football leagues and competitions.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: International competition coverage is part of the stated scope of content coverage.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to view detailed team information at any time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Access to team details is explicitly named as part of the information offering.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to view detailed player information at any time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Access to player details is explicitly named as part of the information offering.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall display live stream links within the app when a live broadcast has begun.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Displaying stream links at broadcast start is a directly stated feature and can be tested against event timing.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall display live stream links only when transmission rights are valid for the user's country.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Rights-based availability is an explicit business rule governing stream visibility.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall enable users to retrieve live results of their favorite teams in real time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The LiveFootball app should also give users the option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Real-time retrieval of favorite-team results is explicitly requested and distinct from merely displaying a ticker screen.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall include an integrated live ticker module to retrieve and display live match data in real time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "To implement this function, the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: The existence and purpose of the live ticker module are explicitly described.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The live ticker module shall continuously update current match data in the user interface.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The live ticker module communicates directly via the interface with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Continuous updates in the UI are a concrete behavioral requirement for the live ticker module.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall retrieve live data for the live ticker module via an API from an external server.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: The integration mechanism for live data retrieval is explicitly specified.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall provide additional modules that allow users to configure the app individually.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition to the live ticker module, the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app"
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: User-specific app configuration through modules is explicitly stated as supported functionality.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall integrate with a notification system that informs users about current events when notifications are activated.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Furthermore, the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Notification delivery based on user activation is directly described as a system function.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall provide registration at app startup.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Registration at startup is a clear functional requirement around onboarding.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall provide login at app startup.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Login at startup is a clear functional requirement around onboarding and access.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to follow favorite clubs.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs"
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Following clubs is a core personalization function that drives other features such as tailored content and alerts.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to receive notifications about news related to their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Favorite-team news alerts are explicitly stated as a personalization outcome.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to receive notifications about results related to their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Favorite-team result alerts are explicitly stated as a personalization outcome.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to share news directly from the app via social media.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Social sharing of news is explicitly stated and is testable through sharing workflows.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall allow users to share game reports directly from the app via social media.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Social sharing of game reports is explicitly stated and is testable through sharing workflows.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall be fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of 2 seconds after startup.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a measurable performance requirement with a clear threshold and startup event.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The user interface shall enable users to access app information directly.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This describes a usability/accessibility quality expectation for the UI rather than a discrete feature.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall remain usable when network connectivity is limited.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Therefore, the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a reliability and resilience requirement concerning degraded network conditions.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall remain usable offline during temporary loss of connection.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Offline usability is a non-functional resilience/availability characteristic under connectivity loss.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The system shall support up to 100,000 concurrent users on match days without performance loss.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "On match days with a particularly high number of accesses, our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a measurable scalability and performance requirement defining expected concurrent load.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall undergo thorough testing before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Pre-release testing is a quality assurance requirement intended to improve reliability before launch.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall be supported through a pre-release support process to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: The stated support process is a quality/operational requirement distinct from testing alone.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The product team shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve app functionality.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a continuous product quality improvement requirement rather than an end-user feature.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall process all personal user data in compliance with the GDPR.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: GDPR compliance is a legal and regulatory non-functional requirement governing data handling.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The app shall maintain compliance with transmission rights when displaying live stream links.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Of course, it is ensured that compliance with transmission rights is maintained."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Rights compliance is a legal and business-rule quality constraint on content availability.
